name: Kandarp Digi Smart BPO Limited
summary: Kandarp Digi Smart BPO Ltd. provides business processing outsourcing services. The firm also offers services such as call center, contact point verifications, site visits, document check pickup, skip tracing, employee back check, staffing solutions, payroll management, payment collections, and AMC booking services. The company was founded on February 7, 2001 and is headquartered in Noida, India.
